correctness.rationale: The leaf attachment identity W_(m+1)=W_m+m+S_U and s_v(m)=m*(H_m+H_(v-1)-3+2/v) give the conditional deviation delta_(i,v). Future independent attachments multiply that deviation by prod_(m=i)^(n-1)(1+2/m)=n(n+1)/(i(i+1)). g(v)=H_(v-1)+1+2/v has g(1)=g(2)=3, strictly rises for v>=2. Mean-zero parent average forces a crossing, while g(floor(a i)) - ((i+1)/(i-1))H_(i-1)->1+log(a) gives tau_i/i=e^-1. Sum conditional P_i=1 covariance across i to derive the exact root-degree covariance n(n+1)*(3/2-3/(n+1)-H_(n-1)^(2)+H_(n-1)/n). Independent complete enumeration n=2..7 checked conditional means, Wiener means and covariance. Scope restricted to uniform recursive labelled trees.
